content: {"like":["Enjoys well-edited, visually striking action films featuring strong performances by Gal Gadot and Connie Nielsen.","Prefers romantic dramas with high production quality and beautiful cinematography.","Values concise, plot-driven thrillers that showcase effective editing and blending techniques.","Appreciates golf instructional content that is relaxed, practical, and helpful.","Enjoys niche collector’s editions that highlight rare, above-waist shots and unique pairings."],"dislike":["Dislikes low-quality black-and-white footage and vintage crackling sound in older films.","Avoids movies that feel like a waste of time and money due to poor storytelling.","Rejects thrillers with overly tight deadlines that create rushed plots.","Dislikes films where the lead female character is underdeveloped or sidelined.","Prefers titles that match their cover art; dislikes misleading packaging."]}
